description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.

description.en: Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
DeepSeek Harness enhancements: Markdown theme for every renderer, select-text annotations with pins, and a narrower sidebar. 中文：DSH 增强插件——Markdown 主题、划词批注、侧栏宽度。
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
AI百事通：右侧边栏�? AI 对话框，默认使用 DeepSeek API 流式问答 (AI chat panel in the right sidebar, streaming Q&A through the DeepSeek API by default)
550C 开机动画 + 登录授权界面：启动时播放 550C 片头，之后可走一段可交互的访问授权（UEG 联合政府 / 550C 控制终端两套主题），点击或 Enter 推进、Esc 跳过；通用设置里可切换或关闭。

DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-event task-completion and attention sounds for turn-end / approval / question / plan-review / goal-blocked / task-failure, each with its own sound (built-in synth, local audio file) and volume, with a separate subagent channel (Web UI)
Create Blender product scenes in DSH with editable recipes, model imports, previews and PNG/MP4 delivery; includes workbench and agent configuration.

DeepSeek Harness companion for ClineBot / ClinePass: dynamic subscription models sync, quota exhaustion warnings, session metrics, dedicated settings page, live usage limits, and /cline slash-command.
Local recording and meeting transcription for DSH on macOS (Apple Silicon only)
DSH Archive Manager - preview, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
OpenAI-compatible LLM adapter plugin for DeepSeek Harness with configurable default sampling parameters (temperature / topP / topK / penalties / seed) over a providers dict.

Configurable sandbox bundle: replaces the shipped process-sandbox provider and filesystem fence with implementations that add extra writable roots, read-only roots and access denials on top of the upstream semantics.

Personal dsh bundle: session modes (coding / chat) as data — a mode is a persona plus the tools it may use. The host applies the current mode to each session, and the new-session chip plus the session-header label replace the official agent-preset surface.

Thin-shell fork of @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent: takes over the `subagent` row only to replace the continuable-child return guidance with Chinese wording; everything not intentionally changed is imported from the vendored upstream source
Ollama-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web): one web_search backend calling POST https://ollama.com/api/web_search.
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.

DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, or WSL on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render the session brief — the todo list (the `todos` projection board) plus the artifact list (a live produced-files feed, codeplan artifacts marked) — as a summary tab in the right sidebar, and shadow the official composer-band todo panel so the board…
DSH plugin for local GSV-TTS-Lite voice cloning + Edge cloud simple mode: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, read-aloud button, settings panel
Neumorphism soft-UI theme for DeepSeek Harness web — gentle raised-and-recessed surfaces in a cream light and an ink-dark palette. · DeepSeek Harness 轻拟物主题:柔和浮起与凹陷,奶油浅色与墨蓝深色两套配色。

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move,  (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.
L0~L3 分层蒸馏记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：自动捕获对话（L0）、抽取原子记忆（L1）、整合场景块（L2）、蒸馏核心画像/团队方法论（L3），并在模型步骤前自动召回注入。移植自 MemoryCore (TencentDB Agent Memory) 的管线设计。
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
DSH Web 插件：会话管家（合并包）—— 会话历史文件（归档浏览与清理）与健康检查（体检 → 处方 → 出院），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索索引（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出）。不碰会话日志、只做可逆处置。
One plugin for a calmer DeepSeek Harness: reading view + message rail + smart history loading, for Harness 0.1.0-0.2.1 (all rc).
连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
obra/superpowers skills provider plus system-prompt bootstrap for DeepSeek Harness

Codex-style Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: Windows desktop control, screenshots, UI Automation, human input handoff, approval gates and prebuilt native workers. Install and update from dsh-market without PowerShell 7 or build steps.

Quality-of-life tweaks for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Chrome-style session tab bar, edge-swipe sidebar, IME/keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, full-screen mobile settings and more — 19 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings page, with instant effect and per-browser persistenc…
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core
Firecrawl-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web)
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
